description.value: Each working of magic has a unique scent and frequency of vibration. You have trained yourself to recognize the minute differences in magics, as if distinguishing between different odors. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This scent can only detect creatures, items, and effects that are currently under the effect of a spell or have the arcane, divine, magical, occult, or primal trait. In addition, you may use [[/act track skill=arcana]], [[/act track skill=occultism]], [[/act track skill=nature]], or [[/act track skill=religion]] instead of Survival to [[/act track]] creatures you could sense with this ability.
